item.title: [threat-intel] Sweden reports cyberattack attempt on heating plant amid rising energy threats
item.description: Sweden says a pro-Russian group attacked a heating plant in 2025. The failed cyberattack highlights growing threats to Europe’s energy infrastructure. Sweden has blamed a pro-Russian group linked to Russian intelligence for a failed cyberattack on a heating plant in 2025.
